_comment: Which typeface pairing each stijl.letterontwerp value means, and which font
directories a client that picked it has to ship. Read by BOTH src/lib/stijl.ts
(to build the font-family stacks) and astro.config.mjs (to copy only the needed
woff2 files into dist/fonts/). One file so the CSS and the copied bytes cannot
disagree: a stack naming a family whose directory was not copied is an invisible
fallback to Arial on a client's live site.
'dirs' are directories under fonts/. 'display' is the heading face, 'body' the
running text; equal values mean one family does both. 'val' is the fallback stack
appended after the webfont, and is the whole stack for systeem.
